subject: Thank you for the smooth airport transfer
body:
Hi team,

Just wanted to share some feedback on my airport transfer yesterday (booking BK-482913). The driver, Ramesh, was punctual and very polite, and the car was clean. Great service overall - thank you!

Regards,
Priya Mehta

subject: URGENT: Driver did not turn up - passenger stranded
body:
This is the second time this month. Our CFO was waiting at Terminal 2 for 45 minutes for booking BK-483001 and the driver did not turn up. He missed his meeting. This is unacceptable - please escalate immediately and call me on +91 98200 11223. If this happens again we will terminate the contract.

Arjun Rao
Admin Manager, Globex India
